content: Tsahad Yeeso ha aten pǝpedyid hura
Farɗa sǝ ɓagha fingya Farisaya tǝ famalǝmngya ngyakhrha a Urshalima ɓa, wuma nda thlǝmad Yeeso ɓa.
Ƙǝla nda hai fingya fatsahaya Yeeso kanda a hǝb ǝnnarhami haryi ndan tǝ “Paarha”, ndǝna haryi ndan kula tsaɓrha ɗǝ.
Ƙǝsǝr Farisaya tǝ Yahudaya mba nda hǝb ǝnnarhami kanda kula tsaɓang har ndan ɗǝ wa, ƙǝs nda ǝntin shingya ha.
Nǝghǝn kee ƙǝm mba nda kii ˈya hiina nda ɓa ahu kasu wa ƙǝl tsaɓang na nda haryi ndan ɗǝ ˈwan. Na ǝntingya sǝ ƙǝm hangga na nda lafrha, ƙǝla tsab ɗengya tǝ ɓǝǝya tǝ tasaukya tǝ ɓaleeya tǝ ǝnfuya.
Tǝrgha Farisayini tǝ famalǝngya ngyakhrha tsahang mee nda Yeeso, “Kama mbuwana fatsahayiwa takkwa ǝntin shingginǝm, na nda a ǝna ˈya mii tǝ har paaya?”
Nggǝmangga Yeeso kanda, Kun fa thlǝrɓuya! A ten nun ni thlǝkna annabi Ishaya pathɗiya, ƙǝla nanǝn chichireethlee hai tǝ ndaarha,

content.text: “‘Nafiniya, ahu mii ndan ni kee na nda fǝre mamnggirha,
amma hur yi ndan nǝghǝn inggun ma nggi;
ka ni kee na nda a tǝree shilee teena,
ƙǝsǝr ɗǝfangganda tsahad ǝntina a mbee,

content: “Malanggun ˈya ndana Faara ƙǝs ǝntina nun ha ǝnana chichiyi nun.”
Ndanggǝn kanda, “Kar ngyakhrha Faara nun fa ka a laf ngyakhrha ǝntin chingginun nun!
Ƙǝsǝr ndagha Musa, ‘Fǝrang mamnggirha nda muwa tǝ tsu,’ tǝ ƙǝm, ‘Kala niifa ˈyargha chin nduwa man na nda ɓǝlang nda.’
Amma nduwun, a ndang niifa chin nduwa man, ‘ˈYa niya kya ɗang nda kunsǝ, ˈwaɗi teena ɗǝfangɗi ndǝn Faara ɗǝ,’
tǝrgha mbun malang niifɗiya ɗanggǝn chin sǝ nduwa man wa.
Tsawanggun laɓar Faara mbǝ ˈya ni na ngga wa, ka ǝntin ngginun. Nun naarha ǝna ǝngya kee hangga.”
ˈYa na tsawang nda niifa tǝ ɗimiyirha fa a mbed Faara
Fiya wumngga hai nggǝrgha Yeeso aah kanda thlǝmadghǝn ɓa, ndanggǝn kanda, “Keema thlǝmarha fa kun heu, a sǝn ǝnɗanun ya.
ˈYa na a ƙǝshi kyagha hur niifa ɗǝ mbǝ ndǝna tsawang tǝ paarha wa, amma ƙǝl ˈya na a kyarha sǝ ahurghǝn ndǝna tsawang nda tǝ paarha fa.
Yi na tǝ thlǝmad sǝkrha sǝkƙǝnǝn.”
A kwasamadɗi malna Yeeso fiya kyanǝn hur minda hai, fatsahayighǝn tsahang mee nda ha aten karapu ɗi ya.
Tsahangga Yeeso mee kanda, “Sǝnanggun hai wa? Mbun a naghǝn wa ˈya kyagha hur niifa ɗǝ a ƙǝshi mbǝ ndǝna tsawang nda tǝ paarha fa wa?
Ƙǝsǝr kyawa ahurghǝn hai wa amma ahu mbǝbǝlǝmndǝghǝn ɗǝ, nggǝrghǝn kyarha sǝ a fadghǝn.” (Thlǝk nǝn pathɗiya a kyad ndaarha nǝn ǝnnarhami heu na nda ngga.)
Ɗǝgha mbeeɗǝ tǝ ndaarha, “ˈYa na a kyarha ɓa ahur niifa ndǝna tsawang nda tǝ ‘paarha fa’.
Ƙǝsǝr ahur niifa sǝ, ndǝna numad ǝn mbǝlfeeya kyarha ɓa, susuwayirha, ngaara, ɓǝl farha, kulafayirha,
kwit hura, mbǝlfeerha, nggaɓarha, suna, sǝrǝkkirha, sǝb thlǝma, nggǝm alteena, tǝ yamid huteena.
Ən mbǝlfeeyini na heu ya na nda kyarha sǝ ahur niifa; nǝn tsawang niifa ‘ɗimirha.’ ”
Tǝrgha Yeeso mal Nggalili nǝn ɗǝgha hu chehweed Taya ɗǝ tǝ Sidon. Kyagha hur minda hai mbǝ midghǝn sǝ a sǝngga fiya sǝ wa, amma mbǝ mbang ɓǝɓeng ɓadghǝn ɓa wa.
A mbǝɗi kee, nuneefa sǝ na wutaradghǝn tǝ ǝnkaheerha fa, sǝknǝn laɓar Yeeso ɓagha ɓa ɓǝrgha hai a mbedghǝn.
Nuɗi tǝ Helenarha ni, nggǝtgha ndan a Fǝnikiya a chehweed Suriya. Hwan Yeeso nǝn a kyanggǝn ǝnkaheedɗa sǝ a fad wutaradghǝn.
Ndangga Yeeso, “Malang wundakhnaya ˈwan nggaala nda, ƙamngwa tǝranggǝm ǝnnadmid wundakhnaya fǝranggǝnǝm wuɗaya wa.”
Ndangga nuɗi Yeeso, “nǝghǝn kee, Chinǝm, amma na wuɗaya ǝna fǝfǝsǝrra ǝnnarhami na a hǝra hai ahar wundakhnaya.”
Ndangga Yeeso, “Ƙǝsǝr ka laɓarɗi kyawa nggǝreena sǝ ya, wiu fayiwa, ǝnkaheedɗi kyaɗa sǝ a fad wutarad wa.”
Ɗǝgha nuɗi wure ɗǝ ɗǝgha wal wutaradɗi keeghǝn kath hu sǝra, ɗǝkɗa hai tǝ ǝnkaheedɗi.
Ƙǝnang Yeeso Niifa na teɓeng tǝ tip
Tǝrgha malgha Yeeso chehweed Taya kyagha tǝ chehweed Sidon tǝ chehweerha na tǝ Talya Kum ɗǝgha wuri aam Nggalili ɗǝ.
Na nafiya sǝ ɓagha ɓa tǝ niifa a Yeeso na teɓeng tǝ ƙǝm mbǝ mbang kaala sǝ wa. Hwanggǝnda a ɗǝfang haara nǝn teena.
Ɗǝgha Yeeso tǝ teɓeng ɗi man patu ɗǝ ma fiya, panggǝn wan haryighǝn ahu thlǝmadghǝn ɗǝ. Chakh yakhrha nǝn hai, tsuwar sheneu niifɗa nǝn.
Ƙǝlagha Yeeso talara sǝ yibgha fa kaan ndanggǝn, “Ifata!” Ndǝna “Inuɗǝ!”
Tǝrgha ingga thlǝmad niifɗa ɗǝ, kwasgha sheneuƙǝn hai nagha a ndikrha fa ngga.
Ndangga Yeeso kanda a pǝrang ndan niifa wa. Amma ndǝghǝn aten yanang kanda, kanda aten pǝrghǝn ɗǝ.
Ƙǝsgha ǝnwulteena fiya kaan na nda a ndaarha, “Ənaɗǝ ǝngya heu ngga, ƙǝnanggǝn teɓengya tǝ fingya mbuwa mbang kalasǝ.”
